pass_criteria: Linux smoke: two conditions (0 and 5 percent forward loss), one three-second transfer per condition, all ten declared observations recorded, receiver bytes/time/rate consistency and 35..60 ms loss-free idle RTT for a configured 40 ms path.

Arithmetic: exact source/text hashes and unique page/quote/token identities; valid mean, difference, relative percentage and strict ordering; mismatching reported results detected; missing, ambiguous, invalid and recorded zero remain distinct; no eval or source instructions executed.

Database: actual isolated PostgreSQL migrations, controller, queue and worker persist one shared run for two claims, two claim protocols, two claim-check links, one experiment reservation, and separate source-reported values and calculated measurements.

Sharing: source/version, actual input bytes, configuration, seeds, metric bounds, resource limits and replication multiplicity must match; prose labels and different claim comparison rules do not create duplicate acquisitions. Every claim retains its protocol and explicit configuration mapping. Shared observations are not independent replications.

Retry: only confirmed terminal HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 failures with matching transient error codes; preserve the failed turn before scheduling a new turn with 15..300 second backoff. Never replay uncertain calls, experiments, expired leases, authentication failures or exhausted subscription grants. Every new call uses existing atomic budget/deadline checks.

All backend regressions, targeted infrastructure assertions, TypeScript builds and frontend regressions pass. RLS, browser-write denial, owner-only mutations, immutable evidence and original assessments remain intact.

missing_and_exclusions: No trials or failed software checks are silently discarded. New invocations get new directories. Missing usage is null, not zero. The short Linux smoke is not substituted for the manuscript's three 30-second trials per loss condition.
